description: Provisional configuration for the Ravan AI one-dimensional longitudinal scenario pilot.

coordinate_convention.axis: one-dimensional; positive in direction of travel

update_equations.position_next: if acceleration < 0 and speed + acceleration * dt < 0, integrate only to stop time (-speed / acceleration); otherwise position + speed * dt + 0.5 * acceleration * dt^2

simulation.synchronization: Update ego and lead from the same time index using piecewise-constant acceleration for the step.

derived_features.ttc_definition: gap_m / relative_speed_mps only when gap_m > 0 and relative_speed_mps > 0
derived_features.time_headway_definition: gap_m / ego_speed_mps only when gap_m > 0 and ego_speed_mps > 0
derived_features.drac_definition: relative_speed_mps^2 / (2 * gap_m) only when relative_speed_mps > 0 and gap_m > 0

scenarios.name: steady_safe_following
scenarios.expected: gap remains 30 m; TTC undefined; no contact

scenarios.name: closing_on_steady_lead
scenarios.expected: gap decreases at 5 m/s until contact or episode end; initial TTC is 6 s

scenarios.name: lead_brakes_ego_no_response
scenarios.expected: lead speed decreases after 2 s; gap then decreases; contact/event outcome is recorded

scenarios.name: lead_brakes_ego_delayed_response
scenarios.expected: ego braking begins at 3 s; same initial conditions as S3 enable comparison

scenarios.name: safe_braking_control
scenarios.expected: verify no contact and record minimum gap; this is a candidate control, not assumed safe by label

scenarios.name: non_closing_pair
scenarios.expected: gap increases; TTC undefined and never zero

scenarios.name: vehicle_stops_without_negative_speed
scenarios.expected: both speeds clamp at zero; neither position decreases

provisional_notice: All parameter values and scenarios are research-pilot settings, not validated safety thresholds or real-world claims.
